purpose: Quantify how strongly the expanded 27 strict phenomenon/session roots are concentrated in a small number of shared selection, observation or instrument families, without treating those family labels as causal explanations or effective sample size estimates.

selection_process_families.interpretation: Twenty distinct clock-event roots are preserved, but their capture and interpretation are shaped by a shared salience-triggered clock observation and same-number lookup process. They must not be modeled as twenty IID minute draws.
Three separate software-world sessions share the Janus_Genesis environment and therefore a common platform/failure domain.
Two temporal roots belong to one Cathars semantic-resonance case and one retrospective interpretation pathway.
One dream-report session with later symbolic interpretation.
One frozen Storm timing experiment/session whose many timing trials remain dependent children.

hidden_connection.name: OBSERVATION_INFRASTRUCTURE_COMMON_MODE
hidden_connection.meaning: The expanded graph has much greater event-level granularity than selection-process diversity. This explains why recurrence can look numerically large even when much of it is produced under the same observation and interpretation machinery.
does_not_mean: all events are the same event
five selection families are five independent evidence samples
selection mechanism fully explains every observation
the remaining events prove prediction or precognition

implications_for_future_testing: Future clock testing must log all observation opportunities or use a null that reproduces salience-triggered capture.
Candidate-vs-null comparisons should be blocked or stratified by selection_process_root.
A future relation is stronger if it transports across a genuinely different selection/instrument family rather than recurring inside the dominant clock family.
Alternative-predecessor and temporal-rewire controls from JANUS-CONNECTION v2 should be applied within matched artifact classes.
Independent evidence root count remains NOT_ESTIMATED until external or sufficiently independent failure domains are demonstrated.
